ideas.pitch: An online assessment platform tailored for college students featuring timed logic challenges, algorithmic problem simulation, and detailed performance analytics.
ideas.title: PlacementPredict - Engineer's Day Competitive Coding & Aptitude Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core theme of Engineer's Day and the competitive coding background of Navachar - Code Fest 2026, appealing heavily to the student organizers from the Entrepreneurship Cell.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent platform combining RAG to help college students debug competitive programming code and explain complex data structures in real-time.
ideas.title: CodeMentor AI - Multi-Agent Student Support & Coding Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven winner pattern of multi-agent student support platforms from the GreenNovation Hackathon while addressing the exact needs of student coders.

ideas.pitch: A gamified portfolio and problem-solving tracking platform for college students to showcase their algorithmic capabilities and technical projects to peers and recruiters.
ideas.title: SkillMatrix - College Talent Showcase & Problem-Solving Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the E-Cell's objective of providing students with a platform to showcase problem-solving skills and enhance logical thinking.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser-based competitive programming arena enabling college students to challenge each other in rapid-fire 15-minute coding duels with instant test case execution.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel - Real-Time 1v1 Competitive Coding Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the competitive coding nature of the fest with engaging multiplayer mechanics built within a strict 48-hour solo development scope.

ideas.pitch: An AI utility that scans student resumes, maps them against historical competitive programming and aptitude metrics, and generates personalized interview preparation roadmaps.
ideas.title: ResumeParser & Aptitude Matcher for Campus Placements
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate, practical utility to college students preparing for campus placements, matching the entrepreneurship and career-development focus of MIT Meerut's E-Cell.
